first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An airborne person wearing a red-and-blue bodysuit and a red full-face hood, initially facing away from the camera, with a white radial pattern on the blue back.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: The light gray sky background above the cluster of buildings and in the gaps between buildings in the latter part.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: The brown buildings with window grids on both sides of the road, the tall gray building on the right, and the continuous buildings in the distance.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: The gray longitudinal road between the buildings, the intersecting junction, and the adjacent curbs.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: Groups of green and yellow-green tree canopies distributed along both sides of the road and in the gaps between buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: Light-colored, dark-colored, and yellow to yellow-green cars arranged in groups on the visible roads.

entities.name: Thin line pulled by the person
entities.identification: A light-colored thin line extending upward from near Person A's hand on the image-right side, with no material or offscreen anchor specified.

entities.name: Building facade billboard
entities.identification: A collection of horizontal billboards attached to building exteriors, chiefly the visible yellow and blue-purple billboard faces on the left.
